name: Darkspear Strand
summary: At Darkspear Strand, the tribe’s refuge begins on Durotar’s southern coast. The trolls came ashore after exile from the Echo Isles and built Sen'jin Village nearby under Vol'jin’s leadership.

sections.title: A Shore of Exile
sections.body: The Darkspear trolls came ashore here after losing the Echo Isles. When witch doctor Zalazane seized their home, survivors crossed the narrow waters and landed on this coast. They gathered just yards inland rather than scatter into Durotar’s hostile red wastes, and built Sen'jin Village. The strand looks across the surf toward the islands they still hope to reclaim.

aliases: why is it called darkspear strand
faq.answer: The Darkspear trolls landed on this coast after fleeing the Echo Isles. When Zalazane turned against his people, survivors crossed the water and gathered nearby to establish Sen'jin Village.

faq.q: Why did the Darkspear leave the Echo Isles?
aliases: why did trolls leave echo isles
faq.answer: The Darkspear left the Echo Isles after witch doctor Zalazane betrayed his kin and enslaved the minds of his fellow tribesfolk with dark voodoo. Chief Vol'jin led the remaining uncorrupted trolls away to escape total subjugation, and they landed on this strand.

faq.q: What settlement is located next to Darkspear Strand?
faq.answer: Sen'jin Village sits just yards inland from the beach. Refugees founded it after landing, and it is the Darkspear’s main outpost and spiritual center in Durotar.

angles.text: For Darkspear trolls, this shore recalls Zalazane’s betrayal and their escape to found Sen'jin Village.
For the Horde, this strand marks where the Darkspear made their place on Kalimdor’s southern coast beside their Orc allies after losing their island home.
